method: As-served release source. CPU self intervals after reconstructing and stably sorting sample timestamps, clipped to s6-start/end marks; no inclusive double counting. Known compilation is the main-thread trace union; native/program gaps are not interpolated. Ordered replacement of source declarators by name=0 stubs without reoptimising unrelated code; remaining compression interactions and stubs are charged to later parts/startup. Peeling is an attribution convention, not executable variants.
